# cloudtower_vm_placement_group (Data Source)

CloudTower VM placement group data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudtower_vm_placement_group" "database" {
  cluster_id    = "cluster-id"
  name_contains = "database"
  enabled       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Filter VM placement groups by cluster ID.
- `cluster_id_in` (List of String) Filter VM placement groups by cluster IDs.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter VM placement groups by whether the group is enabled.
- `id` (String) Filter VM placement groups by ID.
- `id_in` (List of String) Filter VM placement groups by IDs.
- `name` (String) Filter VM placement groups by name.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter VM placement groups by a name substring.
- `name_in` (List of String) Filter VM placement groups by names.

### Read-Only

- `vm_placement_groups` (List of Object) The matching VM placement groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_placement_groups))
